entities.summary: South Sudan is a sovereign nation in East Africa, Africa. Its capital is Juba. Official languages include English. Government: Federal presidential constitutional republic (transitional). Population: approximately 11.5 million. Area: 619,745 km². Comprehensive index for South Sudan covering Nilotic peoples, Shilluk Kingdom, Mahdist and Anglo-Egyptian Sudan, civil wars, CPA 2005, independence 2011 (world's newest country), civil war 2013-2020, and humanitarian crisis.
